bio.text: Lisa Murkowski has served as a U.S. Senator from Alaska since 2002; she was appointed that year and elected to a full term in 2004.
She was re-elected in 2010 in a write-in campaign, and again in 2016 and 2022.
Murkowski was born in Ketchikan, Alaska, and was raised in communities across the state.
She chairs the Senate Indian Affairs Committee and the Appropriations Subcommittee on Interior-Environment.
